Description: Backoffice dashboard listing the packages you publish to nuget.org — download counts, latest version and a short summary per package. Add specific packages by URL, hide the ones you don't care about. Umbraco 17 (net10.0).

AuthorDetails.Name: SplatDev
AuthorDetails.Description: SplatDev Ltda — building Umbraco plugins and tools for agencies and developers.

Screenshots.Caption: Every package you publish, sorted by downloads, with the latest version and a one-line summary. Deprecated and vulnerable packages are flagged.
Manage — the owner accounts to source from, packages added by URL, and anything you have hidden.
